messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick post-all-hands thread: thanks for the questions today. Capturing the hiring & org clarifications here so managers have a single reference. Please add any Qs.

Jonas (CTO): Short version: Q3 plan = net +40 hires, split ~55% eng, 25% product/ops, 20% GTM/support. Priority buckets: runtime reliability, platform automation, devex. We expect most hires to be L3-L5.

Priya (Finance): Budget note: we have a headcount envelope and runway assumptions. We can fund senior lateral hires mid-quarter but are pausing new L1/L2 IC reqs until we confirm capacity for onboarding costs. If a team thinks an L2 is critical, submit a cost/impact blurb to People Ops + Finance.

Abe (ENG Manager - Platform): Clarify: does the pause include internal backfills for entry-level? I have one associate role vacated.

Maya (People Ops): Abe 1: internal backfills for entry-level still allowed if they were in the Q2 plan; new entry level reqs will be reviewed weekly. Backfills should be posted with "internal-first" flag where applicable.

Sahil (VP Eng): Hiring process tweak: for infra roles were adding a short "scale scenario" question to take-home exercises to see systems thinking. Also interview panels should include one cross-team engineer for platform hires.

Elliot (Recruiter): Sourcing note: agencies can keep sending profiles but prioritize seniors & staff-level candidates. Also: relocation budget reduced for remote hires; we'll add a relocation exception flow for critical hires (requires Priya sign-off).

Maya (People Ops): Leveling guidance: managers wanting to up-level a req (e.g., L3->L4) must provide 2 bullets: 1) expected impact in 6 months, 2) justification vs internal career progression. Tag @Sahil for technical sign-off and @Priya for budget.

Jonas (CTO): Communication guidance: we are framing this publicly as a "targeted Q3 hiring ramp focused on infra & platform". Avoid words like "freeze" or "fire-hire".

Maya (People Ops): I'll produce a one-page summary (approvals SLA, internal-first backfill guidance, relocation exceptions, take-home change) and upload to the hiring handbook by tomorrow AM. DM me for urgent approvals.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-targeted-plan (doc id: 412)

Abe (ENG Manager - Platform): Thanks all 1 will queue the req and flag internal candidates.

Elliot (Recruiter): Will start outreach for senior infra next week and share scheduling lanes.

Maya (People Ops): Appreciate the quick responses :pray:
